description: CARF-Models F4U-1D Corsair 1:4.5 class: 2.778 m span F4U-1D Corsair, Moki S250 radial with a 30x18 three-blade, retractable taildragger, slotted flaps. PROVISIONAL physics derived by research/f4u-corsair/F4U-07/derive_physics.py (F4U-07) from the R59 visual master measured at 1/4.5 (F4U-06), NACA F4U data, the CARF manual and the Moki manual's operating points. Experimental catalog aircraft; not flight-identified.

research/f4u-corsair/F4U-07/derive_physics.py: m = M (x_CG - x0) / (x_ballast - x_CG) for the reference balance point; a virtual reference build, NOT measured hardware or a ballast recommendation

crash_hull.source: Points that hit the ground first (le frame) from assets/aircraft/f4u-corsair-250/geometry-r59.json (F4U-06: R59 visual master measured at 1/4.5; provisional until g1); the propeller probes use the physical 30 in propeller, the diameter the renderer draws

mass_range.source: anchors for this kit with a Moki radial, at constant wing loading (x (b / their span)^2); a dry anchor adds half the tank; target = mean of the anchors, rounded to 0.5 kg; range spans the anchors; anchors: CARF-Models specification, dry: 39-46 lb (18-21 kg) dry, midpoint (carf-models.com/en/products/f4u-1d-corsair; nexusmodels.co.uk/products/carf-f4u-1d-corsair-1-4-5-790000); Model Airplane News review, Moki 250, SEP 32x18 2-blade, Sierra retracts, hydraulic wing fold: 53 lb on 2,090 sq in (modelairplanenews.com/carfcorsair)

inertia_reference.source: UltraStick25e Jxx Jyy Jzz (1.959 kg, 1.27 m span); compared after scaling by m·b²

aileron.source: high rate = the CARF manual's recommended normal-rate throw / the median low/high ratio of three Corsair manuals. CARF manual (https://carf-models.com/files/product/34/ed/06/corsair_manual.pdf): aileron 20 mm up / 15 mm down (mean), elevator 20 mm, rudder 70 mm, converted on this airframe's widest surface chords (aileron 0.093, elevator 0.128, rudder 0.235 m; NACA area fractions)

elevator.source: high rate = the CARF manual's recommended normal-rate throw / the median low/high ratio of three Corsair manuals. CARF manual (https://carf-models.com/files/product/34/ed/06/corsair_manual.pdf): aileron 20 mm up / 15 mm down (mean), elevator 20 mm, rudder 70 mm, converted on this airframe's widest surface chords (aileron 0.093, elevator 0.128, rudder 0.235 m; NACA area fractions)

rudder.source: high rate = the CARF manual's recommended normal-rate throw / the median low/high ratio of three Corsair manuals. CARF manual (https://carf-models.com/files/product/34/ed/06/corsair_manual.pdf): aileron 20 mm up / 15 mm down (mean), elevator 20 mm, rudder 70 mm, converted on this airframe's widest surface chords (aileron 0.093, elevator 0.128, rudder 0.235 m; NACA area fractions)

aileron.source: normal rate = the CARF manual's recommended throw, as a fraction of the high rate (the median low/high of three Corsair manuals: Black Horse F4U-1D 2.28 m (BH64); Seagull FG-1D 87 in; Phoenix Model F4U 1.8 m (PMMA1845))

elevator.source: normal rate = the CARF manual's recommended throw, as a fraction of the high rate (the median low/high of three Corsair manuals: Black Horse F4U-1D 2.28 m (BH64); Seagull FG-1D 87 in; Phoenix Model F4U 1.8 m (PMMA1845))

rudder.source: normal rate = the CARF manual's recommended throw, as a fraction of the high rate (the median low/high of three Corsair manuals: Black Horse F4U-1D 2.28 m (BH64); Seagull FG-1D 87 in; Phoenix Model F4U 1.8 m (PMMA1845))

aero.source: Derived from the measured planform by research/f4u-corsair/F4U-07/derive_physics.py (Helmbold/DATCOM, VLM downwash and ground effect, strip theory, Schrenk/Reynolds stall, drag build-up); report research/f4u-corsair/F4U-07/derivation.md. Not calibrated or flight-identified.

CL_max.source: three equal-area strips: Schrenk on the measured chord, NACA TR 586 23012 clmax(Re) x XFOIL thickness trend, less 0.05 finish; flaps up

CL_min.source: cambered section: inverted stall earlier than upright, as the P-51

stall_blend_width.source: 230-series sections stall more abruptly than the P-51's laminar section (full-size F4U stall warning inadequate, NACA RM A7C05)

sideslip_blend.source: Sideslip range where the linear beta terms (CYb, Clb, Cnb) give way to their sin(beta) form, finite and restoring up to knife edge

conventions.rates: p_hat = p·b/(2V), q_hat = q·c/(2V), r_hat = r·b/(2V)
conventions.elevator: per radian, positive = trailing edge DOWN (dCm/dElev < 0)
conventions.aileron: per radian per surface, positive = trailing edge DOWN; right and left listed separately
conventions.rudder: per radian, positive = trailing edge LEFT (dCn/dRud < 0)
conventions.axes: lift, drag, side force in wind axes; roll, pitch, yaw moments in body axes about the aero reference point

CL0.source: research/f4u-corsair/F4U-07/derive_physics.py: cambered wing at its mean incidence + tail at zero body alpha (no trim calibration)

CLa.source: research/f4u-corsair/F4U-07/derive_physics.py: Helmbold x cos2(gull) + downwashed tail (VLM downwash)

CLda_each.source: research/f4u-corsair/F4U-07/derive_physics.py: strip theory over the measured aileron span

CD0.source: research/f4u-corsair/F4U-07/derive_physics.py: component drag build-up at 23 m/s, gear up

CL_minD.source: minimum drag near half the zero-alpha wing lift

propulsion.description: Moki S250 five-cylinder four-stroke radial turning a 30x18 three-blade. Shaft balance with an ignition limit, calibrated blade-element tables, up and right thrust, propeller normal force and P-factor, tail slipstream with swirl (research/f4u-corsair/F4U-07/derive_physics.py).

landing_gear.description: F4U-07: retractable taildragger: two main wheels and a steerable tail wheel (E1 spring-dampers, E2 tyre friction, E3 field surfaces) on the shared retractable-point-gear-v1 law. Kinematics from R59's retract rig scaled 1/4.5; timing, travel and drag are estimates.
